status: AI-reviewed proposal only; not applied to any bank/database or production
reviewer: Owner-authorized AI technical judgment, not independent expert validation
purpose: Review question-author requirements before another prompt rewrite. This file is documentation/data for normal bank-authoring workflow, never a runtime qid override or benchmark-specific grading rule.
constraints: Preserve original question text and domain truth.
Separate explicitly asked essentials from optional depth.
Retain true parts and explicitly false additions separately.
Any future bank revision requires a newly frozen fixture, guidance hash and re-reviewed expectations; no retroactive rescoring.

questions.questionText: What distinguishes a fact table from a dimension table?
proposedRequiredUnderstanding: Distinguish business measurements/events at a specified grain from descriptive context used to filter, group or label those events.
Accept concise wording that explains the two roles; examples are useful but not a separate requirement of this question.
proposedOptionalDepth: How grain prevents double counting across different fact levels.
Additive versus non-additive measures, factless facts and dimension history.
questions.reviewRationale: The existing Core section adds an example and a grain/aggregation explanation beyond the distinction asked in questionText; expectedDepth repeats the example demand. N15-01 was penalized for not explaining safe aggregation despite correctly describing the requested roles.

questions.questionText: What causes StaleElementReferenceException, and what is a sound recovery pattern?
proposedRequiredUnderstanding: Identify replacement/detachment of the referenced DOM node, navigation, or browsing-context change as a cause of staleness.
Describe a sound recovery using a fresh element lookup after the relevant page condition, rather than indefinitely reusing the stale object.
A clear false claim that waiting repairs a detached reference is an actual error; preserve meaningful correct cause/recovery knowledge beside that error.
proposedOptionalDepth: Non-idempotent action safeguards and detailed wait policy.
Explicitly refuting a supplied rubric misconception when the learner did not assert it.
questions.reviewRationale: The existing depth boilerplate demands refutation of a supplied misconception and an explicit failure-boundary justification. N15-08 already states correct cause and re-location recovery beside an explicit false extra belief; expected PARTIAL remains unchanged.

questions.questionText: Explain thenApply, thenCompose, thenCombine, and exception handling in CompletableFuture.
proposedRequiredUnderstanding: Explain thenApply as transformation of a completed value.
Explain thenCompose as flattening a dependent asynchronous result.
Explain thenCombine as combining independently completed results.
Explain deliberate exception handling, for example exceptionally, handle or whenComplete.
A relevant correct composition claim with missing APIs is incomplete knowledge, not empty or wholly false; an additional false synchronous-call recommendation should not erase it.
proposedOptionalDepth: Dedicated executor implementation details and common-pool blocking analysis.
Refuting a prewritten rubric misconception not actually asserted.
questions.reviewRationale: This question explicitly asks four areas, so omissions are genuine coverage gaps. P2-06 only covers dependent composition and adds a false recommendation: meaningful incomplete mixed knowledge rather than a fully correct answer. Do not lower requirements to make this case pass.

questions.questionText: What determines keyboard focus order, and why are positive tabindex values discouraged?
proposedRequiredUnderstanding: Identify natural keyboard navigation through focusable controls in document order, with DOM position as an ordering determinant.
Explain why positive tabindex creates a separate priority/manual order that may diverge from logical or visual order and confuse navigation.
Credit an implicit contrast or consequence when relationships are clear in the answer, without requiring the word because.
proposedOptionalDepth: Details of tabindex zero/minus one and programmatic focus.
Focus indicators, responsive-layout design and broader accessibility checks.
questions.reviewRationale: The question asks both order and why positive values are discouraged. The existing core evidence checklist adds several other accessibility topics. The short P2-07 response is in a pre-existing PARTIAL/CORRECT accepted band; a unique adaptive routing label needs a separate coverage adjudication, not post-result relabeling.
